title: Onboarding Hearing Catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog of onboarding hearing items consumed by idd-onboard and instructions-only agents.

version.description: Semantic version of the catalog document shape.

items.description: Hearing items in Step 0, placeholder, then Step 1B order.

id.description: Stable item identity. Placeholder items use the ONBOARDING_PLACEHOLDERS name.

step.description: Onboarding step this item belongs to.

kind.description: Whether the item is a prerequisite check, a template placeholder, or a Step 1B policy decision.

prompt.description: Short English question --hear prints instead of loading the companion docs.

explanation.description: Short English explanation printed with the prompt.

options.description: Enum choices when the template already documents discrete values.

value.description: Canonical option token recorded in a transcript.

isDefault.description: True when this value is the template's documented default.

derivationHook.description: Name of an existing derive* function in idd-onboard.mts.

mapsToConfig.description: JSON pointer into .github/idd/config.json. Absent for docs-only items.
